items.title: 在 GTA 6 Delights 抢劫任务中，帮助还是不帮助弗兰基和马里奥？
items.summary: Frankie wants to know if you can dance, yes or no. What should you say?

content.v: You'll face a choice in Chapter 2 of GTA 6 , when you're ready to help Vicky rob her boss, Frankie, at the Delights strip club in Port Gellhorn. Frankie asks you an important question and you've only got a couple seconds to respond:

"Can you dance? Yes or no, dude?" Frankie has caught you (as Jason) coming in the back door of the club as you and Lucia prepare to rob it. It's ladies night and one of the male strippers is out of commission, but Mario, the lead stripper, gets an idea when he meets Jason. Frankie has the same idea, and asks if Jason knows how to dance.
Yes, they are asking Jason if he can fill in as a male stripper for the show.
Personally, both versions are worth seeing, but Jason playing a stripper, and Lucia's utter delight at seeing him play a stripper, is way more fun.

items.title: 外媒试玩《GTA6》：30帧仅轻微影响体验
items.summary: 外媒PC Gamer组织多名习惯高帧率PC游戏的编辑体验《GTA6》主机版。参与者认为，30帧上限确实可以察觉，但对他们此次游玩的影响较轻，并未像预想中那样明显妨碍整体乐趣。一名编辑使用标准版PS5游玩时，在开场控制Lu

content.v: 外媒PC Gamer组织多名习惯高帧率PC游戏的编辑体验《GTA6》主机版。参与者认为，30帧上限确实可以察觉，但对他们此次游玩的影响较轻，并未像预想中那样明显妨碍整体乐趣。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795124536_324289_jpg_r.jpg
一名编辑使用标准版PS5游玩时，在开场控制Lucia的阶段感到画面迟滞。经过约五小时体验后，他在枪战、夜间驾车和海上活动中已经很少留意帧率。另有编辑认为，游戏节奏较为沉稳，操作也围绕主机限制设计，因此高帧率不像强调快速瞄准的作品那样必要。
不同设备上的体验存在一些差异。PS5 Slim玩家认为稳定性更加关键，只在昼夜光照变化等场景偶尔感觉到掉帧；Xbox Series X玩家则主要在开启后备箱等预设动作中发现波动。对于运动模糊，有人认为它能掩盖抖动，也有人将其调至1或完全关闭。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795122749_434998_jpg_r.jpg
参与者仍希望未来PC版能够提供60帧乃至更高帧率、4K表现及更多图形选项。他们同时认为，如果多人模式的场面更加混乱，30帧限制可能会变得更明显。目前，《GTA6》在线模式的具体形态和推出时间尚未确认。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.summary: 《博德之门3》新一批共12款Mod已经通过主机端审核，现可在PS5和XSX/S下载。这些内容此前仅在PC提供，既包括玩法调整，也涵盖角色与界面外观。玩法类Mod包括建立在战术家难度之上的“残酷难度”、通过增加生命值强化首

content.v: 《 博德之门3 》新一批共12款Mod已经通过主机端审核，现可在PS5和XSX/S下载。这些内容此前仅在PC提供，既包括玩法调整，也涵盖角色与界面外观。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795124455_559886_jpg_r.jpg
玩法类Mod包括建立在战术家难度之上的“残酷难度”、通过增加生命值强化首领战的调整，以及让夺心魔能力变为每场战斗可用的功能。自动拾取模组可直接收集战利品，省去逐件选择操作；“生命吸取”则增加了一个一级死灵法术。
其余内容包括精灵的新头部预设、哈尔辛主题木鸭耳环、由两把新武器组成的神圣复仇者套装、明萨拉卓尔皮靴外观重制、可佩戴珠宝、新骰子外观，以及让数项与莎尔有关的祝福永久生效。
主机玩家可从标题画面的菜单进入由mod.io支持的游戏内模组页面并完成安装。PC模组进入主机前，需要由作者提交审核，以确认兼容性并符合拉瑞安的规则，因此通常会按周分批获准上线。
《博德之门3》在2024年的一次补丁中加入主机Mod功能，目前主机端的选择仍少于PC。此次上线并非游戏本体更新，而是新一批Mod获得了主机发布许可。

items.title: 《GTA6》生活模拟内容引发玩家对《莎木》的联想
items.summary: 《GTA6》开局阶段的生活模拟内容在社交平台引发不少《莎木》联想。部分玩家原本期待迅速投入劫车和高强度行动，实际却把更多时间用在修缮住所、替邻居办事、健身、吃饭以及与随机NPC交谈上。游戏对杰森和露西亚日常生活细节的刻画

content.v: 《GTA6》开局阶段的生活模拟内容在社交平台引发不少《莎木》联想。部分玩家原本期待迅速投入劫车和高强度行动，实际却把更多时间用在修缮住所、替邻居办事、健身、吃饭以及与随机NPC交谈上。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795124286_744387_jpg_r.jpg
游戏对杰森和露西亚日常生活细节的刻画，被认为呈现出与世嘉1999年作品《莎木》相似的气质。《莎木》的战斗内容占比较小，玩家更多时候会在规模有限但内容密集的开放区域内翻找抽屉、驾驶叉车，并向路人询问线索，体验主人公芭月凉的日常生活。
相比之下，《GTA6》早期提供了更多制造混乱的可能，同时也会温和引导玩家参与生活活动。这种设计因此被视为在更成熟的技术和反馈条件下，对《莎木》模拟理念的一种延伸。部分社交平台用户称其为“佛罗里达版《莎木》”或“2026年的《莎木》”，但这些均为玩家比喻和媒体比较，并非官方定位。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795124288_537024_jpg_r.jpg
《莎木》当年据称耗资7000万美元，按通胀折算约为1.4亿美元，但最终未能收回开发费用。《GTA6》的实际预算尚未公开，因此有关它可能成为史上成本最高游戏的说法目前仍属推测。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: Bloober Team首席执行官Piotr Babieno认为，全球危机带来的普遍焦虑正在助推 恐怖 游戏热潮。他同时透露，工作室目前有7个恐怖游戏项目处于不同制作阶段，并希望打造一个能与《寂静岭》《生化危机》并列的新系列。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795124086_311535_jpg_r.jpg
Babieno在Gamescom Asia与Thailand Game Show期间表示，战争冲突、气候紧急状况和经济困难会增加人们对未来的不确定感。在他看来，长期处于这种情绪之中，会让恐怖电影、小说及游戏更具吸引力，也更容易触及规模更大的受众。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795124087_793152.jpg
他表示，这种环境在商业层面对Bloober Team有利，但个人对此感到忧虑。作品的成功也可能成为现实状况不佳的一种温度计，因此他无法毫无保留地庆祝。上述联系是Babieno对市场心理的个人判断，并非已经由行业数据证实的因果结论。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795124087_570418_jpg_r.jpg
Bloober Team自2016年凭《层层恐惧》转向恐怖游戏领域，随后推出《灵媒》《时间旅者：重生曙光》等作品。《寂静岭2》重制版在公布之初曾遭到大量玩家质疑，目前销量已突破500万份。团队还在推进初代《寂静岭》重制版，Babieno则希望未来由工作室创造出一个新的大型恐怖游戏系列。

content.v: 近日黑客大葱哥(Cyberleek)声称已发布《GTA6》Xbox开发版本，但现有内容缺少主执行文件，无法直接运行。所谓泄露版本的真实性及完整性目前均未得到独立核实。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795123891_969128_jpg_r.jpg
大葱哥网站出现了名为“XBOX BUILD 1.0.2.1（NOV 2026）”的链接，社交平台流传的截图据称展示了开发版目录。下载者声称相关种子约为209GB，并有超过一千人参与分发，但这些数字和文件内容同样未获独立验证。
即使压缩内容确实包含游戏资源，缺少主执行文件也意味着它不能直接在Windows或Linux上运行。运行这些内容还需要兼容的执行代码，并解决Xbox软件环境及主机保护方面的问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795123892_963103_jpg_r.jpg
大葱哥表示，缺失的执行文件正在倒计时；如果其加密代币CYBERLEEK市值达到1500万美元，文件就会提前公开，该门槛据称此前为3000万美元。其还宣称Xbox版已能以超过30帧运行，并将获取PS5版本称作备用方案，但没有提供可供独立验证的演示或技术说明。
大葱哥把此次行动描述为针对Rockstar及数字版发行方式的“消费者权益”抗议，同时长期接受加密货币捐赠。Take-Two此前表示，追查泄露者的行动正在快速推进，并曾向Discord发出多份传票。

items.title: 事实核查：《GTA 6》是否会阻止玩家在同性恋夜总会内开枪以及将飞机撞向建筑物？
items.summary: Here's what's true and what isn't true about these misleading Grand Theft Auto 6 claims.

content.v: As players explore Leonida for the first time, misleading claims about Grand Theft Auto 6 have begun circulating on social media as evidence that Rockstar has toned down the series' violence. The two claims I've seen most often are along the lines of:
Both of these claims are misleading half-truths.
Does GTA 6 prevent players from shooting inside of a gay nightclub?
⛔ No, because there is no gay or LGBTQ nightclub in GTA 6.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MukEFn4U4SvDfoXt7t2CrJ-1920-80.png

It is true that you cannot use firearms inside of GTA 6 clubs, such as Nine1nine and The Vault . Grand Theft Auto 5 had the same restriction. But none of the clubs in GTA 6 are specifically presented as gay or LGBTQ clubs.

It is reasonable to speculate that Rockstar would want to avoid in-game scenarios that closely resemble the 2016 Pulse nightclub shooting in Florida—the state Leonida parodies—but the studio has not stated as much.
Do GTA 6 planes just bounce off of buildings?
⛔ No, unless you've turned on a setting which reduces vehicle damage.

Clips of Grand Theft Auto 6 airplanes smacking into tall buildings without taking any apparent damage have been used on social media to claim that Rockstar is intentionally preventing players from replicating 9/11-like crashes, or that the vehicle physics are shoddy.
The clips of ultra-strong planes aren't fake, but are achieved by turning on "Reduced Vehicle Damage" in the gameplay settings.
In the menu, Rockstar warns players that turning the setting on will "significantly change the balance and experience of gameplay."

If you fly into a building without reduced vehicle damage, your plane will explode. It doesn't damage the building, but there's nothing to indicate that Rockstar has manipulated vehicle physics to avoid recalling terrorism.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/BHPqKqLPfA5ZBPetGie6Zb-1920-80.jpg

content.v: R星总裁Sam Houser在《GTA6》中短暂客串，以一名没有台词的路人形象现身。这段彩蛋出现在后期任务中，容易被玩家错过。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795123114_344374_jpg_r.jpg
以下内容涉及后期任务细节。玩家陪同Boobie办事并抵达一家新俱乐部后，他会与Big Mike见面，并挖苦一名正在扫地的当地员工。这个被称作“小圣诞老人”的角色采用了Sam Houser的数字形象，身穿印有R星标志的白色T恤，出场期间没有说话。
这并非Sam Houser首次出现在自家游戏中。他曾为《GTA3》的Ammu-Nation武器店员工配音，《GTA：圣安地列斯》的Downtown Square还能找到该员工的雕像。他也在《GTA：圣安地列斯》和《GTA4》中为少量背景路人及帮派成员配过音。
《GTA6》推出后，Sam Houser还罕见发表声明，将本作描述为一个充满可能性的叙事世界，玩家将塑造自己的感受与结局。此次客串者是Sam Houser，并非已经离开R星目前经营Absurd Ventures的兄弟Dan Houser。

content.v: 外媒PCGamer作者在首发当天体验《GTA6》后认为，当前主机版已经达到很高水准，但仍可能只是游戏长期演进的起点。他所说的“最差版本”并非否定现有品质，而是判断未来PC版、模组及后续更新仍有显著提升空间。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795122748_133062_jpg_r.jpg
游戏目前在地图规模、物件细节和互动密度方面已有出色表现，主机版首发整体也较为稳定，仅出现少量视觉异常。作者特别提到，标准PS5版的非光追阴影偶尔会在反射中消失，并存在边缘锯齿问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795122749_434998_jpg_r.jpg
作者认为，标准版PS5与XSS/X使用较早的RDNA 2和Zen 2架构，未来PC硬件可能带来更高帧率和更丰富的画质选项，并允许玩家细分调整植被、视距及光线追踪阴影等效果。FSR、DLSS和帧生成技术也有望帮助不同配置的PC改善性能，不过R星尚未公布PC版日期。
除硬件性能外，作者还认为模组生态可能进一步扩展玩法。尚未正式公布的在线模式，以及未来的补丁、升级和追加内容，也可能让游戏继续完善。因此，这一观点主要着眼于后续版本的潜力，并非对当前主机版表现的贬低。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: Bethesda与DEVCATS合作申请了辐射题材新作《猫满废土》的商标。它并非《辐射5》或大型角色扮演续作，而是一款围绕寻找隐藏物品展开的小型衍生游戏。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795122642_271852_jpg_r.jpg

items.title: Valve 或将再次提高 Steam 机价格：“内存和存储成本继续以前所未有的水平增长”
items.summary: The 2TB model will be "especially constrained": Valve has closed the waitlist and says it doesn't know how man

content.v: Valve has good news and bad news for anyone interested in buying a Steam Machine. All current reservations for the 512GB model have been fulfilled and there's stock remaining, so if you want one you can just head over to the purchase page and buy it—but the 2TB model is in shorter supply so signups for the waitlist are no longer being taken.
And, sorry to say, there's also worse news: Valve says it won't be able to produce them in the quantities it had planned, and the price could increase.

Despite their high prices, demand for Steam Machines was high enough that Valve implemented a randomized lottery system to buy one: Prospective purchasers signed up for a shot, a randomized selection were put in a reservation queue with a Steam Machine reserved in their name, and everyone else went to the waiting list to be notified when more reservation spots came open.

Valve said in July that it expected to have the reservation queue caught up by the end of 2026 , and that's now the case with the 512GB model: They're in an "an add-to-cart status," meaning that while supplies last, you can purchase one and it will be shipped straight away.

The situation is less happy for people waiting for the 2TB model, though. In an update posted today, Valve said all reservation holders have been sent their invitations to purchase but there are still people on the waiting list; those people won't lose their positions, but no one else will be allowed to join.

It sounds like that situation is likely to hold for at least a few months, as Valve said it expects to have more information on additional supply of the 2TB units to share in January. It also invited people on the waitlist to purchase a 512GB model instead, but warned that they'll lose their spot on the 2TB waitlist if they do.

Nobody likes to downgrade, and 512GB isn't as spacious as it used to be: Phantom Blade Zero requires an astronomical 300GB of free space for its pre-install process. While that's a bit of an outlier, games eating up more than 100GB of storage are very common these days. But Steam Machines are being hammered as much as anyone by the RAMpocalypse , and Valve said that's not changing anytime soon.

"We are continuing to encounter supply constraints for hardware components, which impacts our ability to source parts," Valve wrote in today's update. "For Steam Machine, that is especially impacting the 2TB model, where the number of customers on the waitlist exceeds our current production; even when we are able to build more it will be at smaller quantities than we planned."

It repeated that message in its conclusion: "We are continuing to build more Steam Machine units, but memory and storage costs continue to increase at unprecedented levels; as a result we don't yet know the number we are able to make, and at what price we'll be able to offer them. The 2TB model in particular will be especially constrained."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/wwHuy8RyrjLvYgmstp9zvA-1920-80.jpg

content.v: 《GTA6》第一章取得自由行动能力后，玩家便可自行驾车前往罪恶城，游戏不会设置硬性阻拦。不过，当地主要剧情和更多可玩内容要到第二章末尾及第三章开头才会正式展开。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795122569_923623_jpg_r.jpg
游戏以Leonida为舞台，开局数小时主要讲述Jason在Leonida Keys运毒的经历。获得自由行动能力后，玩家可以从地图上辨认罪恶城的大致位置、设置导航点并直接前往。
提前进城并不代表当地内容已经完整开放。后续剧情建立的联系此时尚未解锁，罪恶城许多商店和服装店的价格也高于Leonida其他地区。由于开局资金有限，玩家早期在城内能够进行的活动相对受限。
第一章只有一段Jason和Lucia与朋友在罪恶城聚会的短暂任务。主线推进至第二章末尾及第三章开头后，两人才会正式进入市区，玩家届时可以获得当地安全屋，并陆续解锁更多支线活动和兴趣点，主要叙事也会进一步转向市中心。
流程建议倾向于等待剧情自然引导后再进城，认为首次驾车抵达罪恶城的演出更具电影感，两人积攒资金后再进入市区也能强化旅程的成就感。不过，这只是游玩路线建议，第一章并未禁止玩家探索罪恶城。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 《露玛岛》将于12月2日登陆PlayStation 5和Xbox。主机版将支持跨平台随进随出 合作 ，PC、PS5与Xbox玩家可以共同游玩。

content.v: 《GTA6》序章及第一章揭示，露西亚与杰森育有一个孩子。这条家庭线索也解释了无论两人的关系如何发展，他们为何仍会共同前行。以下内容涉及游戏开篇重大剧透。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795122680_545444_jpg_r.jpg
游戏开场交代了露西亚与杰森迅速发展的感情，以及露西亚入狱的经过。露西亚失去网约车司机的收入后，无力结清咖啡馆账单，最终冲出店外，并因一次失败的抢劫被捕。她随后恳求警察返回咖啡馆，镜头由此呈现留在现场的婴儿安全座椅和正在哭泣的孩子。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795122681_397273_jpg_r.jpg
相关描述还提到，孩子有着与父亲相似的金色头发。此前服务员提出提供热牛奶，以及露西亚面对账单时表现出的异常焦虑，也在孩子出现后有了新的解释。
后续剧情继续强化了这条线索。露西亚与监狱辅导员讨论提前释放时，首先询问自己能否重新获得孩子的监护权；她把消息告诉杰森后，杰森也立即问起孩子的情况。
R星曾在发售前表示，玩家可以让露西亚与杰森成为恋人，也可以让两人保持单纯的犯罪搭档关系。共同抚养孩子的联系，则为不同关系选择下两人继续同行提供了剧情基础。

content.v: 《GTA6》发售后，男主角杰森·杜瓦尔的演员Dylan Rourke首次公开谈及参演经历。与此同时，R星也在官网公布了本作完整的演员与制作人员名单。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261119/1795052002_736114_jpg_r.jpg
Rourke在Instagram表示，自己多年来见证了游戏制作领域最勤奋、最有技巧的创作者，能够参与这部汇集创造力、才智与意志的作品是一种荣幸。他称自己从中学到了很多，但仍有许多需要学习。

在R星公开的主要演员名单中，Rourke位列首位，Manni L. Perez饰演露西亚·卡米诺斯。名单还包括饰演Donnie的Brad Carter、饰演Cal的Bobby Moynihan、饰演Brian Heder的Stephen Root、饰演Lori Heder的Orlagh Cassidy、饰演Kenton Rees的Machel Montano，以及饰演Andy的Mallory Wu。
在名单中搜索“Jason”会得到54条结果，这反映出本作涉及的制作人员范围较大，但并不代表共有54名角色演员。GamesRadar则将Rourke与Perez的表演以及杰森和露西亚之间的关系视为作品亮点，并评价这是《侠盗猎车手》系列中格外具有共情力的一组角色关系。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 《GTA6》推出后，CDPR多位管理层和项目主创公开向R星致意。他们分别谈及作品规模、世界细节及制作难度，并向开发团队送上祝贺。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795121652_100525_jpg_r.jpg
《赛博朋克2077》官方账号率先发布祝贺内容，以“从夜之城到罪恶城”的说法向新作送上祝福。CDPR联席CEO Michał Nowakowski随后转发，称R星创造了“一部杰作”，并表示自己计划在未来数周乃至数月中探索游戏。
Nowakowski还向整个开发团队表示祝贺，认为完成这样的作品极其困难。《赛博朋克2》副游戏总监Paweł Sasko则表示，从早期观感来看，《GTA6》可能是一部具有世代意义的作品，他也期待体验游戏的世界深度以及对细节的重视。
《巫师4》总监Sebastian Kalemba同样表达了祝贺。他表示自己很想用整个周末游玩《GTA6》，但在此之前仍要回去处理《巫师》项目。

content.v: 《宝可梦：风与浪》多项传闻的源头账号承认散布真假混杂的信息，导致近期流传的地区进化等说法可信度明显下降。该账号的内容此前还曾被其他爆料账号转发。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795121600_735661_jpg_r.jpg
近期出现的登录账号截图显示，@kurwashibamaste与此前被视为另一人的@Mootmonthly存在关联。Moot随后表示，自己设立该账号，是为了调查其他爆料者掌握多少信息以及消息来源。他称，为让计划奏效，账号发布的内容并非全部虚构，而是掺入了真实信息。
当被问及为何说谎时，Moot表示这样做能够让自己获得爆料，并称还会再做。受此影响，大岩蛇、夜盗火蜥、双首暴龙和戴鲁比将获得新地区进化，以及本作不会加入新伊布进化等说法，目前都需要重新审视。
Moot还曾声称，《宝可梦：风与浪》原定于2026年推出，后来因内部延期改至2027年。宝可梦公司已经公布2027年这一时间窗口，但所谓内部延期经过尚未获得官方确认。该账号运营者计划发布视频，说明其对其他爆料者的调查结果。

content.v: Bungie于11月19日维护《 命运2 》服务器，并向所有平台推送4.04／1.199版本更新。更新上线一个多小时后，官方仍未公布正式变更日志，具体修复项目暂时无法确认。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795121542_996333_jpg_r.jpg
此次下载内容被判断可能以小型修复为主，但在官方说明公布前，现有问题不能视为已经修复。游戏当时仍有多项已知问题，涉及奖励、活动、任务、武器、护甲、职业技能、装饰及性能。
其中，玩家达到最高等级并具备重置条件后，可能无法领取供应商轨道中的较低等级奖励。部分万圣节面具预览显示有误，某些机灵外壳未进入收藏或无法正确统计击杀；启动麻雀竞速联盟时还可能陷入死亡循环。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795121543_848334_jpg_r.jpg
其他问题包括“异端深坑”最终遭遇不掉落职业物品，以及部分武器催化剂和全息箔版本武器无法正确解锁收藏条目。多种新护甲套装加成、神器特性和异域装备效果也可能未按预期生效。
更新9.7.0.2后，神器特性选择还会被重置，玩家需要重新选择，或载入保存过相关选择的配装。Bungie同时正在调查Steam版的卡顿和性能下降报告，上述问题是否包含在4.04／1.199版本的修复范围内，仍需等待官方日志确认。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 《GTA6》没有推出Xbox One原生版本，但借助Xbox Cloud Gaming云串流服务，老主机Xbox One也可以在首发日体验本作。外媒Windows Central实测后发现，整体体验比外界预想的更加出色，但依旧存在无法回避的妥协与限制。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261120/1795121382_847043_jpg_r.jpg
云端服务器运行的是XSS的画面预设，再把画面编码后推流到你的XboxOne主机，最高串流分辨率可达1440p。没有新一代主机的玩家，只要拥有 XGPU 订阅、购买过 GTA6 游戏本体，搭配稳定网络就可以游玩。
在网络状态良好的条件下，整体游玩感受很不错。静态场景、慢速驾驶时，1080p‑1440p的画面观感优秀，不拿本地XSX做对比的话，大部分玩家不会感到明显失望。但高速驾驶、激烈追逐这类快速运动场景就会暴露云串流短板：画面细节丢失，会出现马赛克块状压缩失真;夜景暗部画面也更容易出现噪点与糊块。毕竟 GTA6 场景细节密度极高，云串流会牺牲一部分画面质量。
输入延迟方面：网络理想时，延迟感知很低，游玩体验几乎接近本地XSX主机;但偶尔会出现明显输入滞后，高速开车时甚至会直接撞墙。该体验高度取决于你的网速、网络抖动与ping值。
重要限制：PC、手机、电视端不支持《GTA6》的Xbox云串流，仅限定Xbox One/XSX|S主机设备使用。即便你拥有XGPU，也不能在电脑浏览器或者APP上云玩《GTA6》。
另外XGPU会员每个月仅有15小时云游戏配额。GTA6 主线通关就要几十个小时，想要打完主线、完成支线，很快就会耗尽每月时长;超时后需要额外付费购买云游戏时长。微软官方建议至少20Mbps网络，优先使用有线网络，5GHz Wi‑Fi次之，2.4G Wi‑Fi不推荐。
如果你手头只有 Xbox One，云串流是体验 GTA6 可行的方案。但必须摆正预期：画质会缩水，高速场景会有压缩伪影，存在输入延迟风险，还有每月游玩时长上限。网络条件越好，体验越接近主机原生。网络差则会严重影响游戏乐趣。

items.title: GTA 6 拯救你的狗似乎是基于一只非常酷的现实狗
items.summary: One of the first cool things that people discovered in Grand Theft Auto 6 is that if you swim out into the oce

content.v: One of the first cool things that people discovered in Grand Theft Auto 6 is that if you swim out into the ocean too far, you'll find a dog riding a jetski who coaxes you back to shore.

As it turns out, the dog looks to be based on a real-life dog named Loosy who does neat stunts in Florida. In real life, Loosy is a golden retriever whose owner, Eddie Inch, gained viral fame when he rode a jet-propelled hoverboard in Fort Lauderdale as he towed a goggle-wearing Loosy behind him on a jetski.
It seems Rockstar took inspiration from this with GTA 6's own jetski-riding dog. However, GTA 6's dog is a different breed, but it still has goggles like Loosy.
Neither Loosy nor Inch are listed in GTA 6's credits , but it seems pretty obvious that this is a reference to the real-world viral dog.

GTA 6 launched today, November 19, for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game is getting rave reviews , including a 10/10 from GameSpot . According to Sensor Tower, GTA 6 has sold more than 19 million copies and generated close to $2 billion already .

items.title: “我太他妈的苦了”——Doja Cat 恳求摇滚明星将她的音乐加入到《GTA 6》原声带中
items.summary: Doja Cat is extremely unhappy about getting passed over as a featured artist in GTA 6, and she’s making her fe

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/doja-cat-calls-out-rockstar-over-gta-6-snub-1795119810504.jpg
Doja Cat is extremely unhappy about getting passed over as a featured artist in GTA 6, and she’s making her feelings known in several blistering posts on social media.

GTA 6 , like other games in the series, features several different radio stations that players can scroll through as they zoom down the streets of Vice City. There’s oodles of licensed songs on these stations (we don’t even want to think about how costly this was for Rockstar to pull off), and PinkPantheress even hosts one as a DJ, which, of course, plays some of her music.
One artist who wasn’t included in the lineup was Doja Cat — who, as a gamer, was pretty pissed off about apparently getting snubbed by Rockstar for arguably the biggest game of the decade.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/screenshot-2026-11-19-113115-1795118917160.png

“I would’ve loved to have my music on GTA 6. I’m so f**kin’ bitter,” she wrote on Twitter/X on November 19. In another, she tagged the official Rockstar account, writing, “Eat my dick all yall, I love your stupid f**kin’ bitch-ass game.” She tagged them again in a third post, saying, “You broke my heart, pinche culero.”

As previously mentioned, Doja Cat is an avid gamer. She regularly streams on Twitch between recording new albums and touring, often choosing to play a few games of Fortnite while chatting with her audience. She’s even referenced the game in one of her songs (Agora Hills), and also included a cute line referencing the ‘We got xyz before GTA 6’ meme in her song ‘All Mine.’

Needless to say, Doja’s expletive-ridden tweets quickly went viral, attracting no end of discourse from both fans and critics about what artists got featured in the game and those who missed out. Others were quick to remind her that GTA 5 added new songs to its radio station later in the game’s lifetime, so there’s still a chance that she might get to be in the game at some point further down the line.
“They added newer songs on the radio later in GTA 5, so there’s still a chance sis,” one user commented .
“You’re actually a gamer, too, that’s why I feel bad,” another lamented .
“They added music over time to GTA 5. They might do it again. Start campaigning sis,” another encouraged .

GTA 6’s soundtrack features a slew of high-profile music artists, with the likes of Cardi B, Tame Impala, Travis Scott, and Keith Richards being just a few who contributed to the project. Fans can buy the physical soundtrack as a collectible vinyl album, which can be pre-ordered on the IGN store right now.

items.title: 魔兽世界：永远想要摆脱“BiS”装备的想法
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is approaching itemization and "best-in-slot" (BiS) gear differently, with develope

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever is approaching itemization and "best-in-slot" (BiS) gear differently, with developer Blizzard instead wanting players to have more boss- or biome-specific choices.
In the latest episode of the WoW: Forever Podcast , Blizzard dove deep on the MMORPG's itemization changes, how it approached designing Forever's new items, class changes, and more.
On the subject of raid gear and chase items, Forever senior game designer Aidan Moon said something that could be seen as controversial in certain circles of the game's community.
"I essentially want to get rid of BiS," Moon said. "I think that BiS is not a good thing for a video game that's supposed to be about [the] role-playing aspects of it."

BiS is WoW shorthand for essentially the best item that could possibly be in a given gear slot for a specific class. Look up any WoW guide for WoW Classic or modern WoW, and you'll find class BiS gear lists telling players exactly what they should be wearing in order for their character to be as powerful as possible. Endgame in many ways revolves around acquiring your BiS gear, first your "pre-raid" BiS from gear available in max-level dungeons, and then BiS gear, like tier sets, from raids.

It's for that exact reason Forever introduced new items that grant additional stats or effects against certain enemy types or even in certain locations. Moon gave an example of specific items that deal more damage against Murloc enemies, and that players might want to have more gear tailored to fighting against a Murloc boss in a raid encounter.

Forever's raids will feature multiple distinct biomes within them, Moon revealed, giving players more factors to consider when choosing what gear to use for specific parts of each raid. One wing of a raid may be snowy, while another may be cavernous, changing what gear could be more optimal for those encounters.

"I think your BiS should be different [for] every single boss if you're actually making a theoretical BiS list," Moon said. "It should be based on the creature and the biome and a mixture of those two. You might have an item that's really good against snowy, and then another item in that same slot that's really good against Murlocs. Then there's a Murloc boss in a snowy area and you're just like 'Which one do I wear?' And then eventually you get to a point where you're swapping those things out or it's too much cognitive load and you don't want to do that. It's for those players that really want to optimize."

Trying to get rid of BiS lists is a big change for WoW, which has revolved around the idea for over two decades. Players can already encounter some of the itemization ideas Moon discussed while leveling to 60, with low-level gear from dungeons and quests dealing more damage against specified enemy types or even granting additional movement speed in specific zones.
"I don't want you to have to ever think about BiS, I just want you to think about the fight right in front of you and how you're going to fight it," Moon said.

Of course, having more biome- or enemy-type-specific items means hoarding more pieces of gear as opposed to selling old ones when an upgrade comes around. That will no doubt quickly fill up the inventories and banks of players looking to min-max for every possible scenario. Classic WoW is already notorious for having limited bag space, and players running around with multiple sets of hyper-specific gear will only make that pain point worse.

Blizzard sounds like it's aware of that problem. Principal game designer Kris Zierhut said bigger bags are on that way, but that it's not needed right now immediately post-launch. However, Blizzard knows players will eventually need more bag space as well as better ways to organize and search for owned items to make putting together encounter-specific sets of gear easier.

It's a massive change, but the strategy Blizzard is employing seems to be working. Forever's launch broke WoW concurrent and weekly player records , and more than 15 million characters have been created in the MMO so far. Blizzard recently lifted the veil on how Forever's new PvP system will work , revealing how classic WoW's infamous rank grind will now be a thing of the past.

items.title: 育碧正在进行更多大规模裁员，影响其最大的两个工作室
items.summary: Ubisoft has enacted another round of mass layoffs, affecting 166 additional jobs as the French gaming giant co

content.v: Ubisoft has enacted another round of mass layoffs, affecting 166 additional jobs as the French gaming giant continues its cost-cutting program.

The job cuts are happening at two of Ubisoft's biggest development hubs in Montreal and Quebec. A spokesperson for Ubisoft said the job cuts are coming to meet changing production needs, and IGN reported that the layoffs came from teams working on projects that have been "canceled or refocused."

"We deeply value the contributions of these teams and recognise the impact this may have on our colleagues. We are committed to supporting them through this process with care and respect," the spokesperson said. "Those affected are being provided with severance, extended health care benefits, career transition services and other resources."

Ubisoft Montreal is currently working on Assassin's Creed Codename Hexe , while Ubisoft Quebec most recently launched Assassin's Creed Shadows. No further updates are coming to that game, leaving the question of what the team is making next.
In October, Ubisoft said there are no additional Assassin's Creed remakes currently in development , following the release of Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag Resynced earlier this year.
“Our teams are already focused on the next chapter of Assassin’s Creed titles, including projects you haven’t heard about yet, featuring new settings and stories," the developer said.

Ubisoft's restructuring has led to several canceled games, shut-down studios, and layoffs. Trials developer RedLynx is on the chopping block , while 72 people from Ubisoft Singapore–the studio behind Skull & Bones–were recently laid off .

Just today, November 19, Ubisoft released its latest earnings report that mentioned that Ubisoft's third phase of its cost-reduction program remains "firmly on track." Ubisoft is targeting €1.25 billion ($1.37 billion) in cost reductions by March 2028, so it's possible there will be more pain in the company's future.

items.title: GTA 6 中哪里可以看到真正的大脚怪（臭鼬）

content.v: One of GTA's many gags is back in GTA 6: the ol' bigfoot sighting. Well, technically I think it's a " skunk ape ," real-life Florida's maybe real-life boogeyman "cousin" to Bigfoot. Don't get that cryptid family tree twisted. How do I know it's skunk ape? I saw the thing, I swear, and there was a cloud of green stink wafting off of it. Here's exactly where it's at if you want your own smelly primate encounter.
Bigfoot encounter location in GTA 6
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/si8GfBmdUJBKXFLBYzMpZd-1920-80.jpg

The skunk ape sighting I've found so far is just across Gambit Bay from Jason's initial house. Hop in Jason's boat on the dock outside his place and set course for the dead end road on the inside of this peninsula. Before you even make land you'll get a prompt telling you to use Focus Mode to follow the source of the noises.

Hark! It's skunk ape! The creature hightails its stinky hide off into the mangrove-y woods and you'll need to keep using focus mode to chase after. You'll lose sight of it and instead find some creepy effigy thing standing beside a tree. Check it out, get stink-apacitated, and get your not so informative close-up sighting of bigfoot's big feet.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/AbDXpZTybGWYNiqxe6arES-1920-80.jpg

After your sighting, keep your eyes peeled for flyers about the skunk ape posted on storefronts and telephone poles around Leonida. They'll lead you to a mission where you can learn more about the mysterious beast.

items.title: 您的 GTA 6 赛车就是您的 Red Dead 2 马，而且非常完美
items.summary: My whip is my home.

content.v: Every time the very concept of a GTA 6 has come up in the past eight years, I've had just one wistful opinion to contribute: "I hope they make it more like Red Dead Redemption 2."

I'm not a huge GTA guy, but I am a Red Dead head. The sequel is Rockstar's best work (maybe second best now?) because of all the ways it prioritizes roleplay and choice-making by simulating the little things: Mixing tonics, crafting bullets individually, grooming Arthur's mustache. God, I love that stuff.

There was no way Rockstar would repeat all of these life sim-y touches for the louder and faster GTA 6, but I am surprised and elated that my favorite Red Dead 2 feature of them all made the cut: Your car is your horse.

That is to say, Jason and Lucia's personal vehicles are their mobile bases—an essential extension of them. You can't pet or name it, sadly, but it's important to keep track of and take care of your whip, because it's where you keep all your guns and outfits. It's all literally in the trunk: If you want to fetch your shotgun, you have to walk to the back of the car, open it up, and fish it out of a box.

Gone are the days of keeping seven assault rifles, ten SMGs, and four rocket launchers in your back pocket—you can only equip two "long" guns on your back, and large melee weapons like bats have to be stowed away, too. Aside from how cool it is to fish a shotgun out of my trunk like a disgruntled Jason Statham character, the limitation is forcing me to think twice about how to approach missions.

And unlike in Red Dead's lawless towns, the NPCs of Leonida seem to react negatively to the guy walking around with assault rifles on his back. The game tells you early on that police pay closer attention to you when openly carrying firearms—another reason to stow them away when you don't need 'em.

The car trunk is also where extra outfits can be stored. You can bring along five by default (more than Red Dead's saddles allowed), and even this isn't just for vanity. GTA 6's wanted system goes further than police chases: if you lose the cops, your wanted level will linger and cops identify you based on your description, clothes, and your car. The easiest way to go incognito after raising cain is to pull over, pop the trunk, and change outfits.

It's all very smart and cool and I love it. Though I can also understand why others wouldn't—it's a significant break from what GTA has been up to this point. The two gun limit means murderous rampages might end earlier than they used to, and I can foresee getting annoyed the first time I bring a sniper rifle to a shotgun fight and have no way to correct that. But I think this reflects how Rockstar designed GTA 6 to be just as much a life sim as a crime fantasy.

GTA 6 wants me to constantly make choices and consider what a real human would do. Like in one mission last night, I was left alone without my personal vehicle for the first time. Instead of Rockstar suggesting I grand theft an auto, a tutorial popped for calling a cab. So yea, I took a yellow cab back to my car a few miles away, and it was a chill ride, except for the cabbie who rudely shot down my attempts to make small talk. He's lucky my guns were in my car.

items.title: 《GTA 6》的杰森和露西亚演员打破多年的沉默发表新的联合声明
items.summary: GTA 6's lead actors, Dylan Rourke and Manni L. Perez, have broken their multi-year streak of silence about bei

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/image-c755c61e-1fe7-450f-ba86-76b5f1ac6044-1795117431730.png
GTA 6's lead actors, Dylan Rourke and Manni L. Perez , have broken their multi-year streak of silence about starring in the game.

With GTA 6 officially being out now, the game's full cast has officially been announced . Rockstar kept the actors under a veil of secrecy for the better part of a decade, though some fans were able to figure out who they were thanks to some sleuthing. Still, despite this, the actors maintained strong poker faces, and it's honestly commendable how well they kept their roles under wraps. To celebrate the game's launch, Rourke (who plays Jason) and Perez (who plays Lucia) released a joint statement on their Instagram accounts about their experience working on the game.

"Years witnessing the hardest working and most skilled artisans game making has to offer," reads their statement. "We are truly honored to collaborate on this worldwide testament to human creativity, ingenuity, and sheer willpower. So much learned and so much to learn, keep fighting for what you love, stay humble. See y’all in Leonida."

Perez's role was technically confirmed earlier this week when she was nominated for Best Performance at The Game Awards. Jason and Lucia have been receiving all kinds of praise for their hyper-detailed relationship, which allows players to roleplay a romantic and nuanced kinship. There hasn't really been anything quite like it in gaming, though that has also led to some annoyance from a certain group of fans who just want a straight-up crime game without the lovey-dovey fluff.

Still, there is plenty of crime to be found in this game, obviously. GTA 6's sketchy cast of characters is supported by plenty of new, up-and-coming talent along with some more familiar faces like Bobby Moynihan and Stephen Root ( who leaked his own role earlier this year ). Whether this will catapult Perez and Rourke into more mainstream roles following GTA 6 remains to be seen. GTA 5's Steven Ogg (who played Trevor) was cast in shows like The Walking Dead and Better Call Saul following the game's release. Given GTA 6 is likely going to have the biggest launch in entertainment history, these two actors are about to become some of the most recognizable faces and voices in gaming.

items.title: 毛茸茸的社区因 GTA 6 恶搞而分裂
items.summary: Furries are at odds as to whether or not GTA 6's satirical take on anti-Furry sentiment is harmful to public p

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/gta6-furries-blogroll-1795117217714.jpg
Warning: Mild spoilers for a GTA 6 below!
The Grand Theft Auto franchise is known for parodying aspects of American culture, but one particular bit of satire in GTA 6 is causing a divide in the Furry community.

In the fictional world of GTA 6 , being a Furry is illegal. In fact, licensed hunters in Leonida — GTA’s tongue-in-cheek take on Florida — are authorized to “shoot any Furry on sight.” Of course, it’s obvious that the developers at Rockstar were merely poking fun at recent anti-Furry sentiment from the likes of Florida governor Ron DeSantis , but some real-life Furries are worried that this satire might be taken literally by young players.

For instance, a public service announcement from the “Anti-Furry Association" plays on a television channel in the game warning players about the supposed “dangers” of furries, reminding them that “all citizens are required to report any suspicious activity.” This includes phrases and slang that are popular within the Furry community, like “Uwu, Rawr XD,” and “Hewwo.”

Scrolling through the game’s social media apps, players will also come across a news article from the Vice City Horn titled, “Governor Declares Leonida Furry-Free.” Its headline is accompanied by an image of a crying Furry peeking out from behind a red ‘no’ symbol.

The most viral facet in this conversation concerns an in-game event that players come upon at night. In this event, police are in a standoff with a Furry, who taunts the cops training their guns on him as helicopters fly overhead. Players can choose to help save the Furry from law enforcement or watch him get riddled with bullets if they don’t feel like coming to his rescue.

Some members of the Furry community aren’t taking it too seriously. On X/Twitter, where the bulk of this debate is taking place, a Furry user by the name Freaking_Flynn wrote , “I love it, but I feel like this joke would fit more in the Saints Row series than in the world of GTA. But anywho, Furries going mainstream!”

“I can't believe this is real, and I unironically love it,” another Furry netizen named Riley said of the game’s Furry encounter. Commenters beneath their post seem largely in agreement, with many pointing out how the fictional Furry taunted officers to “suck his knot.”

Others, however, are worried about the broader message GTA 6’s satirical take on anti-Furry panic might color public perception of the community. On Twitter, a Furry user named Kineon wrote , “I love GTA and understand this is meant as satire. However, as a Florida-based furry who already deals with regular hate and threats, I’m genuinely concerned that this could end up encouraging more real-world hostility and violence toward us."

“I get this game is supposed to be satire.. But to be blatantly honest... This is just encouraging more hatred, as well as allowing people who don't like Furries to encourage bad intentions, such as actually shooting one in-person,” another Furry user named Venus said . “Considering the fact that there are children who play this series and are being encouraged to do illegal crimes (which yes, it's a video game but still) it's not exactly healthy for such things to be promoted.”

I had the privilege of speaking with a member of the Furry community to get their opinion on the matter. Riley — whose comments we included earlier in this article — elaborated on how they felt about being represented in GTA 6, saying they believe most Furries understand the joke and are generally appreciative of being referenced in one of the biggest pop culture moments of the decade.

“I think speaking on behalf of the furry community can be a little tricky, because we're definitely a community that can be quick to jump on a bandwagon and criticize opinions we disagree with. But in this particular case, I genuinely think most furries understand that it's a joke and are actually really happy to be acknowledged in such a massive cultural moment as the release of GTA 6,” they told me.

“There's something genuinely hilarious about furries being ‘banned’ in Leonida, especially when you consider that the game also gives players the opportunity to help these furries escape from the police and reach a hideout,” they continued. “It's exactly the kind of ridiculous social satire that GTA has always been known for, and I think most of us appreciate being included in it, even if we're technically the butt of the joke!

“I also think there's something really special about furry culture being represented in a game this massive. Whether Rockstar intended it or not, GTA 6 will probably introduce millions of people to the fandom and, unironically, might even inspire an entirely new generation of future furries. Which honestly makes the whole situation even funnier to me.”

Ultimately, Riley felt this situation doesn’t need to “become a serious debate” about the Furry community; instead, it’s just another example of how Rockstar reflects modern American culture in GTA games with “its signature, over-the-top humor.”

I also reached out to SonicFox , one of the world's best professional fighting game players and a notable member of the Furry community, who shared a similar sentiment. "I think it’s clearly satire and very apparent what political group GTA is making fun of," they told me.

items.title: 尽管《GTA 6》是有史以来最成功的游戏之一，但开发人员仍然担心裁员
items.summary: GTA 6 is already an incredibly successful game, and when the dust settles, it'll likely end up as one of the m

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/ultimate-edition-goodtime-gear-01-1782295792418-1795067565426.jpg

GTA 6 is already an incredibly successful game, and when the dust settles, it'll likely end up as one of the most lucrative entertainment releases of all time. Yet some of the developers are still worried that layoffs are lurking around the corner.

GTA 6 is already tied for the best-reviewed game of all time with the original Ocarina of Time, and it's already broken streaming records on Twitch . It'll be a while yet before we get any kind of precise data on how well the game sold, but going off of preorder info , it's going to rake in a ton of money. Despite all of that, Rockstar devs are still worried that layoffs could put a damper on their celebrations.

Rockstar Animation Programmer Nestor Uriarte wrote an opinion piece for The Guardian ahead of the Rockstar union recognition vote. He spent a lot of his time in his op-ed making the case for unionization in the games industry, at one point pointing out, "While the highs of a game release like this can be incredible, game workers have also come to expect other, less welcome side effects: intense overtime in the buildup and mass redundancies in the aftermath."

Uriarte acknowledges that there isn't any indication that layoffs are actually coming, but it's not hard to see why Rockstar devs would be nervous now that the game is out. 2026 has been littered with layoffs. Just today, Ubisoft cut 166 jobs from its Montreal and Quebec offices . Xbox, too, has been notorious for job cuts this year , as CEO Asha Sharma attempts to "reset" the company . Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has even cheered on these job cuts , saying they're "great to see."

In his piece, Uriarte also says the Rockstar team is worried about the role that AI will play in the industry going forward. Back in March, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick laughed off the notion that someone could create a game at the same scale and quality as GTA 6 with a simple prompt, but he did acknowledge in that same interview that some AI tools are still helpful for game creation.

For their part, Rockstar developers want protection from being replaced from those kinds of tools. According to Uriarte's piece, "Across the [gaming] sector, the skills that workers spend years developing risk being devalued as their creative work is replaced by AI. Rockstar has said it is committed to preserving jobs and it has been clear that our games will continue to be made by people. But with recognition we’d have a seat at the table to manage this industry-wide transition together."

The vote for recognition of the IWGB union at Rockstar is currently underway and runs until November 26. If it's successful, would end up being the biggest recognized union in U.K. games history. The unionization effort has been contentious, too, after Rockstar fired dozens of staff members, leading to accusations of union busting .

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/11/buster-sword-1781198691429.png
任天堂最近对《最终幻想 VII 重制版》和《最终幻想 VII 重生》进行了大幅折扣，所以我很自然地屈服并购买了这两款游戏（它们的价格不到 8 美元！）。这笔交易来了又去，但在投入了太多时间在这款游戏中之后，我现在理解了这种炒作。
对于该系列的长期粉丝来说，最好的《最终幻想》游戏的折扣可能并不那么诱人。但随着亚马逊黑色星期五促销活动的到来，许多 FF7 主题的礼物都可以打折。其中一件这样的交易就是这把令人难以置信的 Cloud Strife 复制品剑。它由不锈钢制成，目前折扣至 Prime Day 以来的最低价格。
作为一个真正拥有多把剑的人，我将第一个告诉你没有人真正需要一把巨剑。添加到您的生活中是一件不切实际的事情，而且它们相当昂贵。话虽这么说，剑真是太棒了，《最终幻想 7》成为世界上最受欢迎的游戏之一也是有原因的。因此，如果您真的想为您的生活添加一把厚重的破坏剑，您绝对应该这样做。
克劳德·斯特莱夫 (Cloud Strife) 已成为游戏界最知名的面孔之一，多年来，她加入了《王国之心》、《任天堂明星大乱斗》甚至《万智牌》等游戏中。他的标志性破坏剑几乎和他现在一样具有标志性。
剑本身由不锈钢制成，算上手柄时长约 4.5 英尺。它并不锋利，但应该足够耐用，您可以砸碎一两个旧的万圣节南瓜，而不必担心它会散开。它重约 15 磅，因此如果您有足够的手臂力量，在角色扮演 Cloud 时绝对可以使用它。
这个价格这个划算吗？
这不是我们见过的这把剑的最低价格，但总体来说仍然很划算。随着美国对钢铁和许多海外制造商征收关税，无法保证此类产品的价格会很快下降。因此，如果这是您现在想购买的东西，那么今年的折扣绝对值得考虑，而不是 2027 年。
考虑到这一点，下周还会有更多的黑色星期五促销活动，这把特殊的剑可能会获得更大的折扣。去年黑色星期五期间，它一路跌至 150 美元，并且可能在 2026 年再次出现类似的折扣。然而，由于它专门在亚马逊上销售，因此它不太可能进一步下跌

items.title: 想要开始有效地举重吗？ GTA 6 是一位好老师
items.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and people are discovering all manner of little details in the

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and people are discovering all manner of little details in the game that speak to the developer's commitment to realism. One such detail is the game's weightlifting and general fitness systems, and they seem to be pretty great, so much so that if you're thinking about getting into weight lifting, GTA 6's lessons are a good place to start.

For starters, Jason has a home gym, and that's just smart on his part. Not having to leave your house and head to a gym is a godsend for anyone short on time or for those who simply enjoy the solitude of slinging weight around alone. For Jason, it's even better--he lives on the water, and it looks pretty damn serene heading to his workout pad for a sweat.

If you're thinking about crafting your own home gym, Jason's setup is exactly what you need to get started: a squat rack, bench, kettlebells, barbells, and iron plates. Garage gym expert Cooper Mitchell also pointed out that Jason's squat stand uses 3"x3" uprights with 1" holes, and that's a great choice by Jason--or you--because it means you have universal support for other attachments from different brands that you might add over time.

Jason also has his setup outfitted with horse stall mats , which is another super-smart choice on his part, not only to protect his flooring, but also because they hold up in the outdoor setting that he uses. Having personally invested in horse stall mats for my own home gym, I can vouch for their incredibly sturdy makeup. They are far better than the cheap interlocking styrofoam mats. They cost more and are a massive pain in the ass to get in place due to their weight and structure. But that's just how it is.

I am a little concerned about Jason leaving all of this equipment outdoors, considering it rains a lot in Florida and is very humid. This may not be ideal for his iron plates, specifically, or his rack. That being said, Jason (and Lucia) can also work out at an indoor gym, so they have their bases covered.

Moving beyond the equipment, GTA 6 really nails the details on how to actually build muscle. To maximize your gains, first you need to use proper form. If Jason does not gently lower the bar on chest presses, he fails his reps, and that's basically how it works in real life. Making slow, controlled movements with any free weight is good practice, and it's nice to see the game reinforce this by giving you a fail state when you move the weight too quickly or in an uncontrolled manner. Of course, you can pack on muscle with bad form and so-called "ego-lifting," but it's generally more advisable to focus on your form. Making light weight feel heavy is the real path to gains.

After hitting chest, doing squats, or swinging the kettlebell, GTA 6 encourages you to eat some protein to lock in your gains, and that's also how it works in real life. You can lift all you want, but if you're not eating enough protein, you won't progress optimally. In GTA 6, your protein intake can come in the form of shakes and bars that Jason has at home, or he can head out into the world and grab a bite that way. You also need to rest to feel your best and see the most improvements to your physique in GTA 6, and that's also good advice in real life. When you're in the act of lifting, you're tearing your muscles apart to make them grow back bigger via hypertrophy, but the actual muscle growth happens during rest and sleep.

GTA 6 goes even further with its own dedicated fitness app on your phone that tracks your progress and serves as a reminder to stay, as the kids say, locked in. This is great, and another solid replication of the experience you might have with your own fitness app or watch. A word to the wise, though: Do not get too obsessed with tracking your macros and workouts in the game or in your personal life. Life is meant to be lived and enjoyed, even if it means you're not in "optimal" shape. Your health and fitness journey is personal to you. So go eat a donut and drink a beer at the same time like Jason does . You do not need to have 8% body fat like Take-Two's own CEO Strauss Zelnick does. Enjoy your life, in Vice City and out, but if you want some tips on how to get started, GTA 6 offers a solid foundation to build from.

items.title: 你可以使用这种极其复杂的方法以 60fps 玩 Grand Theft Auto 6
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is finally out for consoles, and it's every bit the visual showcase of the generation that

content.v: Grand Theft Auto VI is finally out for consoles, and it's every bit the visual showcase of the generation that it was promising to be since its reveal. You'll struggle to find a better-looking game on the current generation of hardware, but one concession Rockstar had to make to achieve that was limiting its frame rate--a limitation some players are going to absurd lengths to overcome.

Irrespective of what platform you play on, Grand Theft Auto VI is limited to 30fps. Doubling that to the more desirable 60fps is something current console hardware just isn't capable of with this level of visual fidelity and simulation, which means you'll have to rely on other methods of frame generation to get there. That's the idea that underpins technology like Veyra : an open-source real-time video enhancer that uses your PC and HDMI 2.1 capture card to bring frame generation to your console.

It's a...complicated process. First you'll need a capable capture card (like one of the many from Elgato) that is able to ingest gameplay at 4K over HDMI 2.1. You'll need to connect that to your PC using certified USB-C 3.2 data cable, which needs to plug into a suitable motherboard with True USB 3.2 Gen 2 support. On the pricier end of the requirements, you will need a relatively powerful GPU, with the creators recommending a RTX-40 or newer card from Nvidia in order to tap into the card's Tensor cores (that are used for frame generation on PC). Pair that with an OLED monitor, which is also strongly recommended thanks to its near-instant pixel response times, and you've got everything you need to finally enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI (and more) at higher frame rates.

Veyra is able to take gameplay captured on your console and apply a variety of enhancements over the footage, which is ultimately displayed (and played) through the PC you're capturing the footage to. You can utilize upscaling and frame generation techniques from Nvidia, AMD, and Intel to enhance both the resolution and perceived fluidity of your console games this way, with as minimal latency as possible. Given all the parts in the chain, from your console, to the capture card, and through to your PC, escaping any additional latency is impossible. But Verya is seemingly built with mitigating latency as its highest priority, and seems to achieve that based on feedback from some users on Reddit .

Is it worth it to go through this much hassle to play GTA 6 at 60fps? If you have all the required hardware then it's at least worth a shot, even just for the sake of curiosity. But actually investing in a setup to achieve this is probably overkill. For starters, it requires a PC that will probably be capable enough to play Rockstar's latest sequel at or on-par with the console version once it does land on PC (which will reportedly be sooner than you think). Capture cards are not outrageously expensive, but they're also not free, which can also be said for all the high-quality cables you'll need between each of the three required devices.

I admit, I admire the dedication to playing Grand Theft Auto VI at launch in the best possible way, but I would wager that you're likely going to be spending a lot more time troubleshooting some incompatibility somewhere along this chain of dependencies instead of enjoying the game itself. Still, if you're curious you can find a lot of detailed information about what this setup requires and why, and determine for yourself if it's worth the price to cruise around Leonida with a bit more fluidity.

items.summary: GTA 6 fans have uncovered a handful of Dexter Easter eggs after years of speculating the TV serial killer woul

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/gta-6-dexter-1795102962512.jpg
GTA 6 fans have uncovered a handful of Dexter Easter eggs after years of speculating that the TV serial killer might be referenced in the game.

Rockstar is known for including Easter eggs and nods to films, television, and even other games in the GTA franchise, so naturally, fans expected that Dexter might be referenced in GTA 6. The original TV series took place in Miami from 2006 to 2013, though subsequent revivals and sequel shows moved the series to New York. Many hoped that Rockstar would give a nod to the famous serial killer, who's best known for taking out bad guys — and it appears that they have.

Dexter's apartment can be found in Vice City, specifically near the top of Washington Island. The residence is inside a complex named "Trinity Apartments," seemingly in reference to one of Dexter's most famous villains, the Trinity Killer. If you go to his actual apartment, you will find an AC unit exactly where you'd expect it to be based on its positioning in the show. The AC unit in the series is used as a hiding place for Dexter's trophies, a box of glass slides with the blood of various people he has killed. If you head to the roof, you will also find a knife, rope, and even a syringe, which Dexter uses to sedate people.

Dexter Easter Eggs in Grand Theft Auto 6 🔥 💥 Dexter's Apartment at 'Trinity Apartments' 💥 'Slice of Life' Boat 💥 Tools on Roof including Syringe Located on Washington Island (Vice Beach) https://t.co/q8lnAMR3rH

And finally, you can also find a boat docked near the complex that looks very similar to Dexter's own aquatic vehicle, the Slice of Life. It's unclear if there are any other Dexter Easter eggs in the game, but if you want to find all of these for yourselves, watch the end of the video embedded above. It's possible that there is even a mass grave of body bags under the ocean or a serial killer running around for players to find, but these are things that might take a lot longer to discover.

Either way, it's a fun nod to a beloved show. We included the TV series on a list of films and shows fans should acquaint themselves with prior to GTA 6's release , expecting that there may be some Easter eggs for them. Other players have found references to Miami-based films such as Scarface, as well, so there are plenty of pop culture references to keep an eye out for while playing the game.

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever's player vs. player systems will work much differently than in previous versions of old-school WoW, developer Blizzard has revealed.

While Forever is now out in the wild and breaking records from the MMORPG, how its PvP rank system would work remained largely a mystery prior to launch. Now, Blizzard has shared more information about how players will earn PvP ranks and honor, with the main takeaway being that players won't have to commit to months of grinding or competing with players on their own faction for top ranks.

Honor, a currency earned from killing enemy players and completing battlegrounds and PvP activities, will now exclusively be used to purchase PvP gear and doesn't impact progress towards ranks. Instead, players will rank points by completing daily and weekly PvP quests, fighting in open-world PvP activities like the Gurabashi Arena, and competing in the weekly battleground.

In a video detailing the new system, Blizzard said the rank climb will now feel "more varied and predictable" than in the past, when players needed to farm varying amounts of Honor to rank up based on how other players on their same faction were performing. It will also encourage players to engage in different PvP activities each week, instead of simply doing the most efficient one in terms of Honor gained.

Though it isn't central to ranking up, Honor still remains as a currency and is used to purchase PvP gear. Players can start purchasing PvP gear at lower ranks, and then use Honor to upgrade those items into epics once they've reached higher ranks. At the max rank of 14, players unlock access to epic weapons equal in power to gear from the MMO's endgame raids.

Blizzard said the biggest way to progress the ranks is by completing weekly season journey quests. For those who might be unable to play for a few weeks and worry about falling behind, each weekly quest doesn't disappear and can be completed later in the season.

Forever's PvP rank grind will still take several months of dedicated play (according to Blizzard, players can expect to hit max rank by week eight or nine of a season), but the amount of actual time required will be far less. That's thanks to players on the same faction no longer competing to farm the most Honor in order to achieve top ranks, something that resulted in players of original WoW and WoW Classic grinding battlegrounds for 12 or more hours a day for months on end.

"WoW: Forever's Honor system keeps you coming back each week, rather than grinding every day," Blizzard said. "We hope this is a more approachable system that still provides a healthy challenge as you climb to max rank."

This isn't the first time Blizzard has revamped classic WoW's Honor system. Though it kept the infamous old system in place for WoW Classic's launch in 2019, it finally made changes in 2023 . It kept the Honor grind somewhat intact, but removed the competition between players on the same faction, instead requiring players meet certain Honor thresholds each week to rank up.

Forever looks to be a hit for Blizzard so far, with more than 15 million characters created and a record breaking number of concurrent, returning, and weekly players. Despite the game's massive launch and a banner year for WoW in general, it wasn't enough to snag the MMO a nomination for Best Ongoing Game at The Game Awards .

In other Forever news, Blizzard recently hotfixed a major dungeon exploit that saw some players, including prominent streamers, earn thousands of gold, only for Blizzard to then remove the ill-gotten gains and issue temporary account suspensions to the worst offenders.

items.title: 估计有 200 万热切的 Xbox 玩家利用“新西兰技巧”提前玩 GTA 6
items.summary: Enough people to fill a third of New Zealand’s population changed their console settings to play GTA 6 a day e

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/gtavi-21-1795111175449.jpg

Enough people to fill a third of New Zealand’s population changed their console settings to play GTA 6 a day early. Dubbed the “ New Zealand trick ,” the exploit saw players change their region to appear as if they were in another country where the clock struck midnight earliest.

This happens fairly often for games with a local midnight launch, but GTA 6 saw an unprecedented number of people pretending to be Kiwis. 2 million U.S. and U.K. players took a little trip to New Zealand on November 18 on Xbox alone, according to Ampere Analysis.

1.5m Xbox users in the U.S. took advantage of the loophole, and 600,000 U.K. Xbox users jumped right in with them. The data also only shows some of the story. Playing early is as easy as changing a setting on Xbox, but PlayStation players have to create a whole new account based in the country, and import PSN currency to spend on the store.

These frustrating hoops mean the number was likely significantly lower on PS5, but it probably still wasn’t an insignificant number of people considering GTA 6 game sales are expected to lean heavily towards Sony’s platform. So, the total number of fans using the New Zealand trick will be higher.

New Zealand's official tourism board recently celebrated the launch of GTA 6 by welcoming gamers taking advantage of the trick. "One perk of seeing the sun first? Getting GTA 6 first too," said the post on the New Zealand tourist board's Instagram account.
"We heard a few of you are trying the New Zealand trick to join us. We get it, and we'd love to have you."

While technically against the terms and services of Xbox and PlayStation, the loophole seems to be an accepted grey area for Microsoft and Sony, in so much as neither has said or done anything to clamp down (we've asked for comment). In fact, Xbox has flaunted the trick as a feature for previous game releases. “Kia Ora to all the people who moved to NZ last night!” Microsoft said a Twitter post from Xbox in 2021, celebrating the launch of Forza Horizon 5.
Whether you took the trip or managed to white knuckle it through to the official launch, GTA 6 is finally here and it’s worth the wait. GTA 6 is now the highest rated game of all time . Crikey.

items.title: 即使是我们这些顽固的 PC 游戏玩家也不会被 GTA 6 中 30 fps 所困扰
items.summary: The game wears it surprisingly well, though we'll be less happy if the PC version is similarly capped.

content.v: For a bunch of performance snobs, we are a surprisingly forgiving bunch at PC Gamer. Yes, if you try to insult XCOM, you're going to get a slap, but we've only just started playing GTA 6 ( well, some of us ) and we're mostly over the whole 'only runs at 30 fps' thing already.

It turns out, while we're happy to part with our money to buy expensive components to hit higher frame rates (and earn the right to brag about it), we're also just as happy to settle for less when a game does a lot of other things exceptionally well.

GTA 6 certainly does that. That's the impression I get from most members of the team that have played it so far. Though if Rockstar is listening, when you do get around to our precious PC version, we'd love nothing more than 4K60—maybe more.
James Bentley, Hardware Writer
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nXJvUmhon9WghwJuvDVoHR-1920-80.png

I will no doubt appreciate frames above 100 fps when GTA 6 comes to PC. Heck, I'd even just appreciate going up to 60 fps. But in my handful of hours with the game thus far, I just have simply not been that bothered by it. Be it smart ways of masking low frames, or even just the slower, methodical control approach of the game, I'm less frustrated with my PS5 running the game at around 30 fps than I was recently playing Phantom Blade Zero at well above 40 fps on a handheld PC.

Maybe that's down to the world having a little bit of magic to it, maybe it's the engrossing tone and atmosphere, maybe it's just because it looks so darn pretty. Maybe it's because I haven't got to the game's most hectic moments yet and haven't really needed to hit a headshot with my console unable to keep up with me. I'll tell you how I'm getting on in another fifty hours. Cool, see you in three days, then?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GgdsawGpbSzorU9FDRha5E-1920-80.jpg
Fraser Brown, Online Editor
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/o5oYVAFnHjesaVgoJsQD9E-1920-80.png

I was dreading playing GTA 6 on my OG PS5—a dusty ornament that's been chilling out in my living room this last year doing absolutely nothing. I've got a nice gaming PC in my office (RTX 4090, Intel i9 13900K, 32 GB RAM), so it's been a long time since I've had to deal with games dipping below 80 fps. I have been spoiled.

The second I got to control Lucia, my fears seemed justified. Everything just felt sluggish. But that feeling didn't last. I played GTA 6 for around 5 hours last night (I am very tired) and I haven't thought about the frame rate once since that initial section. Whether I'm getting into shootouts with coke smugglers, speeding through the Keys at night, or bouncing around at sea, GTA 6 looks great and feels great.
I can still tell this isn't 60 fps, but it is smooth.
Fraser Brown

I can still tell this isn't 60 fps, but it is smooth. I'm sure I've encountered drops, but crucially I haven't noticed them. Sure, it's inevitably going to look better and run better on PC, but the lower performance on my PS5 quickly ceased to be an issue, and I'm not regretting playing it on console.
Phil Savage, Global Editor-in-Chief
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4sHLcbB96zPH9vjoBAiMYC-1920-80.png

GTA 6 is the kind of game where an uncapped framerate would be nice, but it doesn't feel essential. Like Red Dead Redemption 2 before it—a game I also played at 30 fps before it launched on PC—its pacing is measured. It feels designed around the limitations of the consoles it's launching on, prioritising detail and depth over twitch-based combat and precise interaction. It's exactly what I'd expect from a modern Rockstar game. Also like Red Dead Redemption 2 before it, I still feel the sense of longing for what this game will look like on PC. Make no mistake: the version currently available is a preview for what GTA 6 will be at its best. It's great, but those who can wait will be treated to a superior experience.

It's also possible that the 30 fps cap will feel more restrictive once the online mode arrives—whenever that will be, and in whatever form it takes. It's one thing to handle a lower framerate within Rockstar's meticulously created campaign. It's quite another in a lobby of other players. If GTA 6's multiplayer is even half as chaotic as the current GTA Online, every frame is going to count.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/jDAfoTeqcUVNPYNfDSs8WH-1920-80.jpg
Jacob Ridley, Managing Editor, Hardware
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2YNigoLXbckPdRPDe3stwA-1920-80.png

As I was booting up GTA 6, I was expecting to be annoyed by the game's paltry frame rate. And I was—at first. Much like Fraser, during the opening scene with Lucia, I saw my fears come to life on the big screen in front of me. Objects juddering and blurring as I swung my camera around in the cramped cell. Did I just waste £80 on GTA 6 on PS5 when I should've held my nerve for the PC version?

Truth is, the frame rate has had nowhere near as much of a negative impact on my experience while I've been traversing the Floridian wilds as Jason. In part, I think that's because there's a lot more going on, as cars, shops, people, and poultry fly past me as I break most state, federal and ethical laws. That reduces the chance of my eyes fixating on any one object and noticing the adverse effects of the game's lower fps, or the ways Rockstar has gone about covering for it.
Low fps is one thing, but motion blur is the devil.
Jacob Ridley

Low fps is one thing, but motion blur is the devil. That's not just my opinion, that's been scientifically verified (sorta) to be the opinion of PC Gamer readers . Admittedly, some motion blur may be required when the frame rate is this low, so I have played around with a few settings in GTA 6 to find the perfect balance. I'd heard through the grapevine that higher-than-default motion blur (default is 3, goes up to 10) may be preferential to reduce the more obvious juddering that is present at low fps, but whoever says that is no friend of mine. I've landed on setting motion blur to 1 on the standard PS5, as it feels the cleanest overall. I wouldn't blame anyone for turning it off entirely, especially on a more powerful console where the frame rate may not dip as much.

Of course, I do agree with the rest of this lot: in an ideal world, playing the PC version, I'd be pushing a much higher frame rate with motion blur banished to the abyss where it belongs, and a full selection of graphics settings to tinker with to my liking. Yet, to my surprise, I'm not as much of a console version curmudgeon as I thought I'd be.
Is the low frame rate noticeable? Yep. Would it be better at a higher frame rate? Also yep. Is the low frame rate a detriment to my overall enjoyment of GTA 6? Only a smidge.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zNmjh4z2Af2rQJbH6z7TiE-1920-80.jpg
Mollie Taylor, Features Producer
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/W9VNF2qWSreZXDkwcVR2tF-1920-80.png

I don't consider myself much of a framerate snob, but I'll admit I was side-eyeing GTA 6's 30fps just a little bit. Well, that was before the game came out. Now that I have my hands on it, with roughly six hours spent lollygagging around Leonida? I'm hardly noticing it, though I'll most definitely be appreciating a smoother experience once the PC version rolls around.

Like Jacob said, motion blur definitely seems to be masking it somewhat—and I am traditionally a motion blur hater, so it's taken a little getting used to—but I'm genuinely pleasantly surprised at the balance Rockstar has managed to strike between a smooth performance and a dense, rich world.
Christopher Livingston, Senior Editor
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/wC7aUjGb8pW4neHoNS25gF-1920-80.png

GTA 6 taught me that I don't much care about frame rates as much as I expected. I got to start playing it a few weeks ago and didn't have anyone to compare notes with, and my first thought was: Huh, they got it to run at 60 fps after all! It all felt very smooth, even when I realized it was 30 fps after all. It was only a bit later I started noticing very occasional drops, like while driving during a gradual lighting chance from day to night.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Huj6GiSGX8B7L5in7CDtiE-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Ti9gYoetCsh9crRvpUzKD9-1920-80.png

Could Grand Theft Auto 6 come to Switch 2? That has been the big question ever since Nintendo officially revealed its console last year, and it's something that we have mused over ever since (as unlikely as it may seem at an initial glance). Now that the game is out, the tech experts over at Digital Foundry have weighed in on the port possibility, and, perhaps unsurprisingly, they don't rate its chances.

In the outlet's latest rundown, it touches on the "compromised" Xbox Series S performance. It isn't all that, with DF noting "frame-rates routinely lingering in the mid to high 20s during ordinary traversal and combat," but it's the system that regularly lands the most comparisons to Switch 2, so DF says that it would be "interesting" to see if it would be "possible for a further cut back version to ship on Nintendo's hybrid console".

items.title: 购买 GTA 6 和 PS5 Dualsense 控制器可在 Argos 限量套装中节省 10 英镑
items.summary: Argos has launched a limited GTA 6 and PS5 DualSense bundle for £99.98, beating Amazon's combined price by £8.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/17/gta-6-ps5-dualsense-bundle-deal-argos-cover-1794925700586.jpg

With GTA 6 finally launching this week, there's been no shortage of retailers offering early discounts on Rockstar's long-awaited Grand Theft Auto sequel, but Argos has gone one better with a new bundle deal that gets you an extra PS5 DualSense controller for a good amount less.

Whilst Amazon UK has recently been listing Grand Theft Auto VI for £64.95 , alongside the DualSense now going for £42.99 in an early Black Friday deal, Argos has managed to undercut both with an all-time low combined price.
Save On This GTA 6 And Controller Bundle At Argos

Specifically, you can now buy GTA 6 on PS5 with a DualSense controller for just £99.98 at Argos , down from the £109.98 total price you'd otherwise pay for the two together. For comparison, this limited-time offer (running until the 3rd of December) beats Amazon’s combined £107.94 price by £8.56.

To put Argos’ savings into another perspective, since GTA 6 is currently listed for £64.99 at the retailer, you're effectively getting the extra gamepad for only £34.99 — or, alternatively, bringing the game's price down to £54.99, if you were planning on buying a new or extra DualSense anyway.

Mind you, this offer doesn't include every PS5 controller colour scheme. You'll have to choose between the original White DualSense or Midnight Black version, both featuring the usual haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and built-in microphone. Neither controller is one of the special GTA 6 editions .

Amazon’s DualSense deal, on the other hand, includes lots of alternative colour schemes at its new £42.99 deal price: White, Midnight Black, Cosmic Red, Grey Camo (surprisingly even lower at £39.94 ), Nova Pink, and Starlight Blue.

If you’ve only just started looking into grabbing a GTA 6 preorder, you’ll also need to remember that this boxed copy of GTA 6 doesn't actually include a physical disc. Instead, you'll receive a download code inside the case, along with an A3 double-sided poster.
The code can already be used to preload the game ahead of its November 19 release, but requires a UK-registered PlayStation account.

items.title: 是的，您正在听到“Weird Al”Yankovic 在 GTA 6 中主持广播电台
items.summary: Also hosting are Lana Del Rey, Bad Bunny, Keith Richards, and—for some reason—Jeremy Irons.

content.v: If you're one of the countless millions contributing to the collective endangering of global productivity by enjoying Grand Theft Auto 6 at launch, you might have paused in the middle of blatantly disregarding traffic laws to wonder: Wait a second, am I hearing "Weird Al" Yankovic hosting this pretend radio station?

And yes, you are: In a Bluesky post earlier today, the beloved comedic musician and polka maestro confirmed that he offered his voice for DJ Al, who hosts '80s music station Vice City FM alongside Swedish actress, model, and singer Brigitte Nielsen. Their contributions were then double-confirmed by the full GTA 6 credits , which Rockstar published once launch time hit.

I’m the host of GTA 6’s “non-stop ‘80s” radio channel Vice City FM. I also wrote some in-game commercials, and I’m the voice of the Burger Shot ads as well! As a long-time fan of the Grand Theft Auto franchise, I couldn’t be more excited about this. Okay, gotta get back to playing the game!

"I’m the host of GTA 6’s 'non-stop ‘80s' radio channel Vice City FM. I also wrote some in-game commercials, and I’m the voice of the Burger Shot ads as well!" Yankovic said. "As a long-time fan of the Grand Theft Auto franchise, I couldn’t be more excited about this. Okay, gotta get back to playing the game!"
Somewhere out there, Weird Al is securing the love of his virtual latina wife, and I think that's beautiful.

Yankovic is just one of countless recognizable names you'll find if you scroll down the GTA 6 credits. Among the core cast, SNL alumnus Bobby Moynihan voices Cal, Jason's bumbling, conspiracy-brained buddy. The pair's criminal boss man, Brian Heder, is performed by legendary Stephen Root—who you'll likely recognize as Bill Dauterive on King of the Hill, Milton in Office Space, and all kinds of magnificent weirdos across the Coen brothers filmography.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/KAVCkMQ6m9p7Ayo6NQ3BdD-1920-80.jpg

But it's the radio talent where GTA 6's credits get particularly wild. It's a cavalcade of international music icons, comedians, and film figures. While driving around GTA 6, you might hear Lana Del Rey hosting Back Country Radio, or Latin music phenom Bad Bunny on Cocoteo FM. On Dirty South Classics, there's Trina, Trick Daddy, and Gucci Mane. Pop station Flash FM is helmed by Robyn and Alex Consani—the first transgender model to win Model of the Year at the British Fashion Awards and celebrated TikTok goofball. Keith Richards is in there. I didn't even know he was still capable of speech.

On talk radio, you can hear Ted Lasso's Jason Sudeikis, Abbot Elementary's Janelle James, and John Leguizamo of being John Leguizamo fame. Stavros Halkias is on there doing a Conservative talk radio bit. But maybe the most compelling inclusion, for me, is that Kaleidoscope FM is hosted by Jeremy Irons. The Academy Award-winning actor. You were in Kafka, Jeremy. How'd you end up in cyber-Florida?

If I wanted to include all the recognizable names on the list, I'd need a dozen more paragraphs, so I recommend you browse the credits yourself. Or just be content in knowing that Weird Al is waiting for you. That works for me, too.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/R4UAoyCLM246CLeZy7wBXb-1920-80.jpg

items.title: 我刚刚在 GTA 6 中发现了一顶非常熟悉的帽子，它出现在我最意想不到的地方
items.summary: Sometimes it pays to follow signs.

content.v: I just found a curious artifact of the Old West in GTA 6, and the best part is I stumbled across it completely by accident.
That's right, partner: Arthur Morgan's cowboy hat is in Grand Theft Auto 6, and you won't find it in some trendy Western fashion shop or in a McMansion as part of a wealthy crypto bro's collection.
If you want to wear it yourself, I'll tell you below where you can find it.
How to find Arthur Morgan's cowboy hat
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Ta3RE2kYKSQX2P9QMvvA4U-1920-80.jpg

I was out in Port Gellhorn looking for a particular kind of car for reasons completely unrelated to clothing accessories. While I was driving, I spotted a sign on the side of the road with a balloon tied to it, reading "Yard Sale" with an arrow pointing down the road.
I followed the sign which led to more yard sale signs and, yup, sure enough, the signs pointed me to an actual yard sale. And among the items for sale was a very familiar-looking hat.
It's called a "Genuine Cowboy Hat" and, this being a yard sale, it only cost $5. But I knew the second I saw it that this was no ordinary cowboy hat. Here, have a look at it from the back.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xuWkVkcdw5ELWWUeEeVeLU-1920-80.jpg

Yep. No mistaking that. I even got a little pang of sadness thinking about good ol' Arthur Morgan. I miss him. Maybe when I'm done with GTA 6, I'll strap on my spurs and take another ride through Red Dead Redemption 2.

Directions : Head to Port Gellhorn. It's in Kelly County on the western side of the state along the coast. In the southern tip of Port Gellhorn, there's a small neighborhood of about five houses just northwest of the Dirt Merchants mod shop.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/TRyze8VuFtoHQkpJMny84U-1920-80.jpg

Look for the driveway filled with yard sale clutter: furniture and electronics and such. There's a bunch of balloons, a cut-out of a nearly naked cowboy, and a big American flag flying. You'll find the hat toward the back sitting on top of a guitar case on a couch. There's also a shirt, a cap, and some shoes for sale that definitely didn't belong to Arthur.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/wzDLzqMW3xiHR7y9iiBjLU-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oxT58sEjcP4M233n5BWwhj-1920-80.png

items.title: 海盗船 Sabre V3 Pro PureVector Ergo 评论
items.summary: Machine learning sensitivity changes to help you aim.

content.v: Corsair is continuing the 2026 trend of brands pushing out new and innovative mouse technologies . In this case, it's all in the 'PureVector' part of the name. In partnership with AimLabs, Corsair has made a mouse that can adjust sensitivity in different directions to tailor it to your movements and help you aim better.

That's the claim, anyway. In practice, I've found that PureVector hasn't improved my aim, both subjectively while gaming and objectively based on multiple AimLabs tests. Some pro players that Corsair highlights claim it's helped them, so your mileage may vary.

Apart from PureVector, though, the mouse itself deserves some attention, as it's still a very performant, lightweight mouse for competitive gaming. It has some upgrades compared to its predecessor, the Sabre V2 Pro , too.
Buy if…
✅ You want to try the latest tech: You might get better results than I did with PureVector. It tailors sensor sensitivity in different directions based on how you aim.
Don't buy if…
❌ You want good value for the basics: If you just want a comfy mouse with solid build quality that performs well, you can find something of better value elsewhere.
Features
Buttons
Connectivity
USB-C or 2.4 GHz wireless
Sensor
Marksman X
Switches
Optical
Feet
UPE
Max DPI
Max acceleration
Max speed
